lcc_original: 天晚起了涼風，永恆主上帝在園中走走，那人和妻子聽見永恆主上帝的聲音，就藏在園子裏的樹木中，躱避永恆主上帝的面。
notes: 天晚 tagged with <WH03117> (יוֹם = day): LCC adds 晚 to render the idiom 'cool of the day' but the underlying Hebrew word is still יוֹם; 天晚 as a unit represents it
UNV's {<WH03068>} is implicit in the second clause (耶和華 not written) but LCC explicitly writes 永恆主 there — braces dropped, SN attaches directly: 永恆主<WH03068>
{<WAH0853>} (accusative marker אֶת) remains implicit in both clauses — no explicit LCC counterpart in either occurrence
走走 (LCC reduplicated stroll form) annotated identically to UNV's 行走 with <WH01980><WTH8693>
UNV's 他妻子 → LCC's 妻子 (possessive pronoun absent); <WH0802> still attaches to 妻子 as the lexical head
LCC comma after 走走 preserved (UNV has a full stop there); LCC's 園子裏 preserved in place of UNV's 園裡
